title: PCR/qPCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates certain steps of the Lyra Direct SARS-CoV Assay. This protocol assumes buffer is being added manually. The automated steps include mixing of the deep well block, and transferring samples to the PCR plate. --- * [P20 single-channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [P1000 single-channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons 20ul filter tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-filter-tip) * [Opentrons 1000ul filter tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-1000ul-filter-tips) * [MicroAmp™ EnduraPlate™ Optical 96-Well PCR Plates](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4483354#/4483354) * [Eppendorf 96 Deep Well Block 1000ul](https://online-shop.eppendorf.us/US-en/Laboratory-Consumables-44512/Plates-44516/Eppendorf-Deepwell-Plates-PF-55960.html) --- Deck Setup * Opentrons 1000ul filter tiprack (Slot 4) * Opentrons 20ul filter tiprack (Slot 7) * Eppendorf 96 Deep Well Block 1000ul (Slot 2) * MicroAmp™ EnduraPlate™ Optical 96-Well PCR Plate (Slot 3, should be rested on top of the Eppendorf cooling block)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load deck hardware
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 1000 µL filter tiprack in slot 4, the Opentrons 20 µL filter tiprack in slot 7, the Eppendorf 96‑deep‑well block (1000 µL) in slot 2, and a MicroAmp™ EnduraPlate™ Optical 96‑well PCR plate in slot 3 (rested on the Eppendorf cooling block). Ensure the robot is equipped with a P20 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette and a P1000 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette. This protocol assumes any required buffer is added manually.

steps.title: Enter sample count and select mounts
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, input the total number of samples (including controls). Example: 38 patient samples + 2 controls = 40 total. Then select the P20‑single‑channel mount for the P20 pipette and the P1000‑single‑channel mount for the P1000 pipette.

steps.title: Upload protocol to app
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, upload the prepared protocol file, and verify that the deck map matches the physical layout described above.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, run the calibration routine for each piece of labware (both tipracks, the deep‑well block, and the PCR plate) and for both pipettes, following the on‑screen prompts and using the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute automated run
steps.instruction: After successful calibration, press “Run” in the Opentrons App. The robot will automatically mix the deep‑well block and transfer samples to the PCR plate as defined by the Lyra Direct SARS‑CoV Assay protocol.
